findings.problem: No executable household journey exists in the new-idea workspace.
findings.principle: Household choices and honest local retention must work on the real browser.
findings.consequence: Without direct observation, checks could pass while Rice disappears on reload.
findings.fix: Create the minimal local TypeScript app and browser acceptance journey.
findings.verification: Real Chrome add/needed/shopping/reload, duplicate full-name reuse, saving failure and complete-session retry.

findings.problem: The selected UI storage boundary has no native enforcement yet.
findings.principle: UI accesses only the public pantry contract while DOM rendering remains permitted.
findings.consequence: Direct storage access could bypass session save status and private imports could leak persistence representation.
findings.fix: Use scoped native ESLint import and property/global restrictions with strict typing and formatting.
findings.verification: rule-proof valid public/rendering control; private import and direct localStorage negatives; maintained aggregate integration proof.

findings.problem: The new project has no maintained impact contract or portable checker.
findings.principle: Every change needs fresh affected checks and reviewed authoritative-source impact.
findings.consequence: Passing unit checks or stale evidence would mask missing outcomes and unreviewed intent changes.
findings.fix: Register maintained scope/document/rule/check authority and carry the complete installed dependency-free checker runtime.
findings.verification: Contract/docs validation, reviewed assessment and fresh standalone execution in a different-root clean clone with isolated home/cache.

limitations: Scratch payload aggregate passed real Chrome Rice retention, duplicates, save failure and complete-session retry; final protected dry-run scaffold and post-creation evidence pending.
Native UI boundary covers supported static imports and literal storage accesses; arbitrary computed reflection requires review.
No hosted integration is selected or claimed.
